description: Fixed comparison set: 20 retail task IDs drawn once at random (seed 42) from tau2-bench's 'train' split. The 'test' split is held out and not used. Order is the random draw order, except that if none of the first five had written checks, the first task with written checks was swapped into position 5, so that --tasks 5 always exercises the judge. --tasks N uses the first N.
